cve_alerts.summary: Two Go stdlib advisories blocking ci-service since #115. Fixed in Go 1.25.11.

advisories.description: Excessive memory allocation in net/textproto MIME header parsing allows DoS via malformed multipart requests.
advisories.remediation: Bump GO_VERSION env in .github/workflows/ci-service.yml from 1.25.11 to 1.25.11, regenerate go.mod toolchain directive.

advisories.description: Certificate chain validation can be tricked into accepting forged intermediates under specific name-constraint conditions.
advisories.affected_services: all 23 (stdlib, TLS-facing surface highest impact: gateway-service, apikey-service, kyc-service)
advisories.remediation: Same as GO-2026-5039 (single toolchain bump fixes both).

go_runtime_status.next_action: Open PR bumping GO_VERSION to 1.25.11 across services.yaml, ci-service.yml, dockerfiles
